---
title: "List Actors"
description: "List actors in a namespace by ID, by name and key, or by name. Listings by name are paginated."
---

{/* Generated by scripts/docs/gen-api-reference.mjs from engine/artifacts/openapi.json and docs/api/endpoints.json. Do not edit by hand. */}

Pass `actor_ids` (comma-separated) to look up actors by ID, or `name` with an optional `key`. `actor_ids` takes precedence over `name` and `key`. Only a listing by `name` without `key` is paginated; a page can hold fewer than `limit` actors while `pagination.cursor` is still set. Destroyed actors are excluded unless `include_destroyed` is `true`. A namespace token needs a grant on `actor` with `list`.

```http
GET https://rivet.example.com/actors
```

## Examples

<CodeGroup>

```bash cURL
curl "https://rivet.example.com/actors?namespace=$RIVET_NAMESPACE&name=counter" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RIVET_TOKEN"
```

<CodeSnippet file="examples/docs/api/actors-list.ts" title="TypeScript" />

</CodeGroup>

## Authentication

Send the admin token, or a namespace token from [Create Token](/docs/api/tokens/create) whose grants cover the request, as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header. The `x-rivet-token` header is also accepted. Routes with a `namespace` query parameter use the `default` namespace when it is omitted. See [Authentication](/docs/api/authentication).

## Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | `string` | No | Name of the namespace to operate in. Defaults to `default`. |
| `name` | `string` | No | Only return actors with this name. Required unless `actor_ids` or `actor_id` is set. |
| `key` | `string` | No | Only return the actor with this key. Requires `name`. Multi-part keys are joined with `/`, see [Actor Keys](/docs/api/actor-keys). |
| `actor_ids` | `string` | No | Comma-separated IDs of the actors to return. |
| `actor_id` | `string` | No | Same as `actor_ids`. Used only when `actor_ids` is absent. |
| `include_destroyed` | `boolean` | No | Include destroyed actors. Must be `true` or `false`. |
| `limit` | `integer` | No | Maximum number of results to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 100. |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | Pagination cursor. Pass the `pagination.cursor` value from the previous response to fetch the next page. |

## Responses

### 200

Matching actors and a cursor for the next page. `pagination.cursor` is `null` on the last page.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actors` | `object[]` |  |
| `actors[].actor_id` | `string` | Unique ID of the actor. |
| `actors[].name` | `string` | Actor name as registered in your RivetKit registry. |
| `actors[].key` | `string` | Actor key. Multi-part keys are joined with `/`, see [Actor Keys](/docs/api/actor-keys). An empty string for an actor without a key. |
| `actors[].namespace` | `string` | Name of the namespace the actor belongs to. |
| `actors[].runner_name_selector` | `string` | Node pool the actor runs in. |
| `actors[].create_ts` | `integer` | When the actor was created, in Unix milliseconds. |
| `actors[].start_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor first started. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actors[].pending_allocation_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor started waiting for a node. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actors[].connectable_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor last became connectable. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actors[].sleep_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor went to sleep. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actors[].reschedule_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor will next try to allocate. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actors[].destroy_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor was destroyed, in Unix milliseconds. Only set in listings that include destroyed actors; otherwise `null`. |
| `pagination` | `object` |  |
| `pagination.cursor` | `string \| null` | Cursor for the next page, or `null` when there are no more results. |

```json
{
  "actors": [
    {
      "actor_id": "d97pbq1nyqxw1w5qdwz0iirbqiblh2",
      "name": "my-actor",
      "key": "my-key",
      "namespace": "my-namespace",
      "runner_name_selector": "default",
      "create_ts": 1700000000000,
      "start_ts": null,
      "pending_allocation_ts": null,
      "connectable_ts": null,
      "sleep_ts": null,
      "reschedule_ts": null,
      "destroy_ts": null
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "cursor": null
  }
}
```

### 400

`actor.invalid_listing`: neither `name` nor actor IDs were given. `actor.invalid_include_destroyed`, `actor.invalid_limit`, `actor.invalid_cursor`: the parameter is malformed. `actor.invalid_key_encoding`: `key` is not in canonical slash-separated form. `envoy.invalid_namespace_name`: the `namespace` value is not a DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | `string` | Error group, for example `actor`. |
| `code` | `string` | Error code within the group, for example `not_found`. |
| `message` | `string` | Human-readable error message. |
| `metadata` | `any` | Extra details. Only present on some errors raised while authenticating or authorizing the request. |

```json
{
  "group": "actor",
  "code": "invalid_listing",
  "message": "Listing actors requires a name or actor IDs."
}
```
